stories.title: Meet the LP: Keebeck Wealth Management
stories.description: The $2.5bn multi-family office has shied away from private equity’s mega-funds due to valuation and liquidity concerns, CEO Bruce K Lee tells PEI Private Equity.

stories.title: Siris’ Frank Baker sees tech-enabled services opportunity with new firm October
stories.description: Baker will stay on with Siris, managing its existing funds and portfolio, while Siris’ latest fund, Siris Partners V, has rebranded as October Capital Fund I.

stories.title: Side Letter: LAFPP's 'terrific' distributions
stories.description: Why mid-market buyout managers may be making a non-emergency call to Los Angeles Fire & Police Pension System, and a departure from Vance Street.

stories.title: LAFPP ups PE pacing amid strong distributions
stories.description: The pension's portfolio has been cashflow-positive each of the last three years at a time when LPs are bemoaning a lack of distributions.

stories.title: Vance Street targets $1.25bn for Fund V as co-founder steps back
stories.description: The fund is about 61% larger than the predecessor, which closed on its $775m hard-cap in 2024.

stories.title: LPs want an edge from emerging GPs
stories.description: In today’s climate, emerging GPs must show a compelling niche, institutional-grade operations and greater flexibility to attract capital.

stories.title: Side Letter: Conflict's a-comin'
stories.description: Why PE may soon be gripped by antitrust anxiety; AI is becoming part and parcel of LP diligence processes.

stories.title: United Methodist Church unit scrutinizes defense tech in PE GP search
stories.description: Jake Barnett, an MD of sustainable investment strategies at a unit of the $28bn investor, says it wants to be thoughtful about the evolution of defense spending.

stories.title: Sheridan lays out deployment plans for $1.1bn flagship, $245m healthcare IT funds
stories.description: Sheridan aims to make its first investment from its fourth small-cap healthcare buyouts fund by the end of 2026.

stories.title: Aussie GP Fortitude closes debut fund above hard-cap
stories.description: Fortitude’s first fund raised most of its capital from Asian institutional investors, with around 20% coming from family office and HNW channels.

stories.title: Centre Lane eyes $1bn Fund VI for complex mid-market situations
stories.description: Centre Lane Partners VI is expected to close later this year or in early 2027, according to Plymouth County Retirement Association board documents.

stories.title: Side Letter: COP out
stories.description: Compensation, value creation and physical risk frustration came to the fore at PEI Group's Responsible Investment Forum: Europe last week.

stories.title: Flexstone: LPs face more 'decision-making' in PE funds
stories.description: Investors are paying closer attention to a GP's use of CVs and NAV financing when considering re-ups, co-CIO and managing partner Nitin Gupta tells PEI Private Equity.

stories.title: Riverside Co taps longtime insider Joe Manning to run Riverside Micro-Cap Fund
stories.description: The 20-year Riverside veteran shares his vision for running the Riverside Micro-Cap Fund, which is now investing from a $1.87bn vehicle.

stories.title: Orange County to double down on co-invest following directs success

stories.title: EnCap Flatrock targets $1.5bn for sixth midstream fund
stories.description: The firm previously raised larger midstream funds, including Fund IV, which closed on $3.25bn in 2018.

stories.title: Side Letter: CV red flags
stories.description: The implications for a poorly handled continuation fund can extend well beyond the transaction itself.

stories.title: Fundraising time on the road: The strategies and regions leading the pack
stories.description: Fundraising timelines are coming down for most strategies, though secondaries and larger vehicles have yet to return to pre-2023 levels.

stories.title: Soundcore preps for Q1 launch of Fund IV with $500m target
stories.description: Plans for the new fund come less than a year after Soundcore wrapped up capital raising for its $450m predecessor.

stories.description: LPs are heading into 2027 with diminished appetite for private equity.
